scope: Read-only diagnosis of frozen 0.2.407 guest native reload; no native rerun, source fix, retry, acceptance or inventory change.

second_working_sibling.observation: Same frozen build guest reload reached post-reload pane/capture work; its later failure was a separate capture boundary.

code_boundary.trusted_fixture_click: tests/browser/native-sidepanel-qa-harness.mjs testPage() posts chrome.runtime.sendMessage to the fixed extension ID and writes the callback into #result, including runtime.lastError when the callback runs without a reply.
code_boundary.observer: beginReloadPanelReplyObservation clears #result, clicks, and observes its content concurrently with a 150-attempt replacement-panel target poll. Closing that observer at target-poll failure leaves reply_not_observed if no content was seen; this category does not establish whether the message was dispatched, delivered, handled, or answered later.
code_boundary.extension: src/lib/background/bootstrap.ts registers onMessageExternal and calls handleFrontendRpc; src/lib/frontend-bridge/handler.ts invokes sidePanel.open before its first await and sends the reply after settling the open attempt.
code_boundary.first_good_to_unknown_transition: The fixture click resolved and the replacement worker was running/activated. Neither fixture callback content nor replacement panel target appeared before the bounded poll ended. No same-request ingress, sidePanel.open invocation/settlement, or callback-lastError observation is in the receipt.

competing_hypotheses.cause: The page click fired but Chrome did not deliver its external message to the replacement worker.
competing_hypotheses.prediction: The fixture records sendMessage invocation and later callback or lastError, while the replacement worker records no matching request ingress.

competing_hypotheses.cause: The replacement worker received the message but its open attempt stalled or failed before sending a reply.
competing_hypotheses.prediction: A matching worker ingress exists; the open invocation/settlement or sendResponse boundary identifies the first missing or refused result.

competing_hypotheses.cause: The worker responded, but the page callback or #result observation was lost, and panel creation separately failed or was missed.
competing_hypotheses.prediction: A matching sendResponse is recorded despite no fixture callback content; a same-window side-panel target/context observation distinguishes creation from discovery loss.

smallest_missing_observation: For one request ID on a future authorized native attempt, record sanitized monotonic milestones at fixture sendMessage invocation, callback entry plus presence/lastError category, replacement-worker onMessageExternal ingress, sidePanel.open invocation and settlement, sendResponse, and CDP panel target creation. Preserve one request ID across both sides; record no raw URL, response, token, or error text. This single boundary trace discriminates delivery, handler/open, and callback/target-observer hypotheses without changing acceptance or increasing the timeout.
limitations: The failed receipt proves a native reload/panel reopening refusal, not a Scrape product regression or cause. The valid resource journals exclude resource-admission invalidity but do not prove why Chrome did not reopen the panel. No causal RED-to-GREEN source guard exists, so no source fix is justified.
